proposed_github_metadata.description: Demonstrate a purpose-declared repository scaffold with traceable engineering conventions.

purpose.statement: Demonstrate how an explicit project purpose becomes a deterministic, convention-anchored local repository scaffold.
purpose.function: Provide a bounded reference consumer for the repository factory.
deliverables: A digest-pinned standards lock and truthful generation manifest
interfaces: Consumes a versioned GitHub Engineering Standards catalog and profile

template_parameters.STATUS_AND_SCOPE: Reference consumer only. It creates local files and does not create or configure a hosted GitHub repository.
template_parameters.REQUIREMENTS: Python 3.11 or newer and a source checkout of github-engineering-standards.
template_parameters.INSTALLATION: No package installation is required for the generated reference files.
template_parameters.USAGE: Review the generated purpose record, standards checklist, and manifest before adding project code or publishing a repository.
template_parameters.ARCHITECTURE: The repository keeps purpose, policy inputs, generated conventions, and project implementation separate. Cross-repository dependencies must be explicit.
template_parameters.VERIFICATION: Re-run the project-specific checks selected for the eventual toolchain. Generation alone is not a passing assessment.
template_parameters.RIGHTS_AND_PROVENANCE: No license is selected by this demonstration. Complete project-specific rights review before publication or redistribution.
template_parameters.SUPPORT_AND_CONTRIBUTION: See CONTRIBUTING.md, GOVERNANCE.md, SECURITY.md, and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md after confirming that each policy names real accountable channels.
template_parameters.DEVELOPMENT_AND_CHECKS: Run the declared formatter, static analysis, unit tests, and integration tests for the chosen implementation before requesting review.
template_parameters.REVIEW_MERGE_AND_FOLLOWTHROUGH: The accountable owner reviews scoped evidence, merges only the intended revision, and records any follow-up work explicitly.
template_parameters.SECURITY_AND_CONDUCT: Use SECURITY.md for sensitive reports and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md for community concerns after their reporting channels have been verified.
template_parameters.OWNERS_AND_ROLES: The repository owner is accountable for purpose, access, review policy, and maintenance. Delegation must name an actual responsible person or team.
template_parameters.DECISION_AND_ESCALATION: Record durable decisions with rationale. Escalate unresolved security, rights, and ownership questions to the accountable owner.
template_parameters.RESPONSE_OBJECTIVES: Triage new work according to impact and maintainer capacity; publish concrete response objectives before accepting external support commitments.
template_parameters.REVIEW_POLICY: Require evidence proportionate to risk. Automated authors do not count as independent human approval.
template_parameters.ACCESS_POLICY: Grant least privilege, review access periodically, and remove access when responsibility ends.
template_parameters.SUPPORTED_VERSIONS: This reference scaffold is not released or deployed. Define supported versions before accepting security reports for a real implementation.
template_parameters.PRIVATE_REPORTING_CHANNEL: Before publication, configure and verify a private vulnerability-reporting channel. Do not use a public issue for sensitive reports.
template_parameters.RESPONSE_AND_DISCLOSURE: Acknowledge verified private reports, scope impact, preserve evidence, coordinate remediation, and disclose only through an approved process.
template_parameters.INCIDENT_OWNERSHIP: The accountable repository owner assigns an incident lead and records containment, recovery, notification, and follow-up responsibilities.
template_parameters.COMMUNITY_SCOPE: These expectations apply to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and project-controlled communication spaces.
template_parameters.REPORTING_AND_RESPONSE: Report concerns through a verified private governance channel. The accountable owner records receipt, recusal needs, and the response decision.
template_parameters.ENFORCEMENT_AND_APPEALS: Use proportionate documented responses, protect reporters from retaliation, and provide an escalation path outside the original decision-maker when available.
